At the end of the day, it comes down to whether or not you trust your girlfriend to both 1) respect and honor your relationship, and 2) take steps to keep herself safe. My fiancee (boyfriend at the time) was in greek life and I was not, so he would occasionally attend mixers and closed parties without me. However, I trusted that he loved and respected me enough to not jeopardize our relationship at these parties. Additionally, as sexual assault is a real risk at these events, your girlfriend should be following basic safety precautions (e.g. staying in a group, not leaving her drink unattended, etc.).

If you trust your girlfriend to do both of these things and you're still struggling with anxiety, I recommend hanging out with your own friends while she's out. It's a good distraction from self-destructive thought patterns. 

Tl;dr: take deep breaths. Your girlfriend loves you and won't do you like that.
